title: NDT Engineer
company: UNITED INSPECTION AND ENGINEERING SERVICES ( K.L ) PRIVATE LIMITED
description:
**Company Description**
UNITED INSPECTION AND ENGINEERING SERVICES ( K.L ) PRIVATE LIMITED is a hospital and health care company headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. The organization focuses on providing inspection and engineering services that support safety, reliability, and compliance in healthcare-related operations. Based out of Parthasarathy Puram in T Nagar, the company works with a range of clients that require technical expertise and quality assurance. Team members collaborate closely with healthcare and engineering professionals to deliver accurate, standards-based inspection solutions. The company offers opportunities for growth in a technically focused, service-oriented environment.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site NDT Engineer role located in Coimbatore. The NDT Engineer will perform non-destructive testing (NDT) activities such as ultrasonic and eddy current examinations on mechanical components and systems, following relevant codes and standards. Responsibilities include planning and executing inspections, documenting test results, preparing reports, and communicating findings to project and quality teams. The role involves supporting quality control processes, identifying defects or non-conformities, and recommending corrective actions to ensure equipment integrity and safety. The NDT Engineer will also assist in maintaining testing equipment, adhering to safety procedures, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to meet project timelines and regulatory requirements.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong non-destructive testing skills, including Eddy Current and Ultrasonics.
* Candidates should possess skills in Inspection and Quality Control for components, systems, and materials.
* Candidates should possess a solid foundation in Mechanical Engineering and related technical disciplines.
* Relevant NDT certifications (e.g., Level II in Ultrasonic or Eddy Current) and familiarity with applicable standards are beneficial.
* Ability to read technical drawings, prepare clear reports, and communicate inspection results effectively.
* Attention to detail, adherence to safety practices, and capability to work on-site in industrial and healthcare environments.
* Prior experience as an NDT Engineer or in a similar inspection role within engineering or healthcare-related facilities is an advantage.

title: Manufacturing Engineer - Assembly, Testing & Integration
description:
The Manufacturing Engineer (Assembly & Testing) defines, documents, and executes the assembly and testing requirements for high-precision Jigs & Fixtures used in Electronic Gadget Manufacturing. This role bridges engineering design and execution by converting drawings into assembly process sheets, check sheets, and cross-disciplinary verification protocols across mechanical, electronic, PLC, and wiring domains. Additionally, this role takes full ownership of end-to-end testing requirements both at the Factory (FAT) and at Regional Customer Sites (Chennai, Bangalore, Hosur) during final commissioning and line integration.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Assembly Documentation & Cross-Linkage Verification
* Process & Check Sheets: Develop Assembly Process Sheets (APS) and check sheets detailing tolerances, torque values, and assembly sequences.
* Cross-Disciplinary Audit: Rigorously verify cross-linkages between mechanical structures, electronic sensors, PLC hardware, and wiring schemes prior to testing.
* Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) @ Toolroom
* Factory Dry Runs: Execute complete factory-level testing requirements, including dry runs of mechanical movements, pneumatic stroke limits, and basic PLC sequences.
* Pre-Shipment Validation: Validate sensor repeatability, signal integrity, ESD grounding, and safety interlocks against drawing specs before packing for dispatch.
* Site Testing (SAT) & Support (Chennai, Bangalore, Hosur)
* Site Acceptance Testing (SAT): Lead on-site testing protocols at customer manufacturing facilities in Chennai, Bangalore, or Hosur under live production conditions.
* Line Side Troubleshooting: Perform rapid debugging of mechanical alignment, wiring drops, or sensor logic errors to achieve successful First Article Inspection (FAI) and zero downtime.

**Technical Requirements**

* Education & Regional Mobility
* Qualification & Experience: B.E. / B.Tech (3–6 yrs) or Diploma (7–10 yrs) in Mechanical, Production, or Mechatronics Engineering.
* Regional Deployment: Willingness to travel to customer plants across Chennai, Bangalore, and Hosur for site testing, commissioning, and issue resolution.
* Specialized Testing Skills
* Testing & Schematic Literacy: Proficiency in reading GD&T drawings, 3D CAD, pneumatic circuits, electrical/PLC wiring diagrams, and executing test protocols.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**
**Key Performance Indicator (KPI)**
**Performance Target / Benchmark**

* FAT First-Time Pass Rate

100% clearance of Factory Acceptance Testing protocols prior to shipment.
  
  

* SAT & FAI Clearance

100% successful site testing and approval during customer FAI at regional sites.
  
  

* Cross-Linkage Accuracy

Zero wiring, mechanical, or logic mismatches identified during factory or site testing.
  
  

* Process & Test Sheet Compliance

100% completion and archiving of Assembly and Testing Check Sheets.

* Handle and work with high\-voltage and high\-current distribution panels, including three\-phase main supply systems.

**Preferred Technical Qualifications**
* Experience in equipment testing, electrical inspection, and calibration.
* Strong knowledge of Electrical Wiring Diagrams (EWD).
* Proficiency in using multimeters and calibration equipment.
* Experience with manual crimping tools and different electrical terminals.
* Experience with high\-voltage/high\-current distribution panels.
* Ability to prepare or interpret electrical CAD drawings.

* Strong attention to electrical safety, testing accuracy, and quality.
* Willingness to work in different shifts, including night shifts.

description:
Company Overview:
   

  

 If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The E\&I Supplier Quality Engineer is responsible for end\-to\-end quality assurance of critical Electrical and Instrumentation (E\&I) bought\-out equipment. The role ensures that supplied equipment meets customer requirements, approved engineering documents, purchase\-order specifications, inspection and test plans, applicable standards, and statutory requirements before final release.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own quality activities for critical E\&I bought\-out items, including:
* Electric motors
* Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)
* Motor Monitoring Systems (MMS)
* Transformers
* Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs)
* Unit Control Panels (UCPs)
* Other electrical, instrumentation, control, and protection panels
* Perform supplier source inspections and incoming inspections in line with:
* Customer specifications
* Approved drawings and datasheets
* Purchase\-order requirements
* Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs)
* Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs)
* Applicable IEC, ISO, customer, and project\-specific standards
* Review and witness routine tests, type tests, and Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), ensuring:
* Approved test procedures are followed
* Test instruments are calibrated and traceable
* Test results comply with specification and standard requirements
* Test reports are complete, accurate, and approved before release
* Apply IEC 60034 series requirements for electrical rotating machines and motors, including motor performance, efficiency, temperature rise, insulation, vibration, noise, routine testing, and certification requirements.
* Verify compliance of Ex equipment with IEC 60079 series requirements, hazardous\-area classifications, Ex marking, protection concepts, equipment certification, and validity of Ex certificates.
* Coordinate supplier inspections, third\-party inspection agency (TPI) activities, customer inspections, and internal quality requirements to meet project schedules and inspection hold points.
* Review supplier quality documentation, including:
* Approved drawings and datasheets
* Material and component certificates
* ITPs, QAPs, and manufacturing schedules
* Routine and type test reports
* FAT reports
* Calibration certificates
* Ex certificates and compliance documents
* Final manufacturing and quality dossiers
* Maintain complete traceability of equipment, components, inspection status, test records, deviations, and release documentation throughout the supply cycle.
* Identify nonconformities and raise NCRs where equipment, documents, or test results do not meet requirements.
* Coordinate with suppliers for root\-cause analysis (RCA), corrective and preventive action (CAPA), corrective action implementation, and closure verification of NCRs.
* Handle customer quality queries, complaints, deviations, and NCRs associated with E\&I bought\-out items, providing timely and technically sound responses.
* Conduct supplier quality audits, vendor visits, surveillance inspections, and remote inspections as required by the project or quality plan.
* Support the final inspection team by reviewing E\&I quality dossiers, ensuring documentation completeness, closing inspection punch points, and supporting Inspection Release Note (IRN) issuance.


**Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience in supplier quality, quality control, inspection, testing, or project quality for electrical and instrumentation equipment.
* Strong exposure to motors, VFDs, transformers, PLCs, switchgear, control panels, and hazardous\-area equipment.
* Strong Knowledge about product certification like ATEX, Compex etc.
* Knowledge of IEC 60034 and IEC 60079 series standards.
* Experience in reviewing engineering drawings, wiring diagrams, datasheets, ITPs, QAPs, test procedures, and supplier documentation.
* Knowledge of FAT, routine testing, type testing, inspection release processes, and quality dossier compilation.
* Strong understanding of NCR, RCA, CAPA, deviation control, and supplier corrective\-action follow\-up.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with suppliers, customers, TPIs, engineering, procurement, project management, and final inspection teams.
* Strong technical judgment in E\&I equipment inspection and compliance verification
* Attention to detail and documentation discipline
* Knowledge of hazardous\-area and Ex compliance requirements
* Supplier quality management and problem\-solving capability
* Clear communication with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders
* Ability to manage multiple inspections and project priorities under schedule pressure

* The ability to travel 20\-30% of the time (within India)

* Experience in New Product Development and ISO Documentation.
* ISO 9001:2015 Lead Auditor and Six Sigma Certification will be added advantage.

**Job Description**




 As a Module Lead, you will play a key role within the eLIMS\-Forensics programme,
   

  





 Eurofins Forensic Services, operating in UK, Netherlands, France, Germany and Belgium, sits at the core of European criminal justice systems, acting as the trusted scientific partner to police forces and courts, and providing critical evidence that enables fair and accurate outcomes in serious criminal investigations.
   

  

 For software engineers, this is a rare opportunity to build systems where code directly impacts real\-world justice—supporting DNA analysis, Forensic Case Management, and forensic workflows that can identify suspects and strengthen legal decision\-making.
   

  

  

  

 The UK forensic ecosystem remains one of the most advanced globally, combining cutting\-edge science, strict regulatory standards, and continuous innovation; advances in data science, AI, and trace analysis are actively transforming how evidence is detected, interpreted, and used in investigations.

 **software development, quality engineering, and forensic domain expertise** 
 , giving engineers direct exposure to highly specialized scientific applications rarely found in traditional tech roles.

 **technical challenge, societal impact, and domain depth** 
 —where engineers are not just building software, but enabling a system that underpins public safety and the pursuit of truth.

* Support modularisation of legacy systems and development of new platforms

* Support modular system design and decomposition
* Contribute to technical concept design and implementation

 Design and optimise backend services and data models
   

  




* PostgreSQL

* JPQL / CriteriaBuilder
* Ensure scalability, integrity and performance of data\-intensive systems

* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps
* Manage containerised environments (Docker)

* Implement automated build, deployment and release processes

title: QUALITY ENGINEER - EV Motor
description:
**Business Unit:** 
 EPS Mobility
   

  

**Role:** 
 Quality Manager/Engineer \- Motor
   

  

 The Quality Manager/Engineer is responsible for establishing, implementing, and maintaining world?class quality systems for
 **EV traction motors** 
 —covering stator, rotor, and motor assembly processes. The role ensures
 **IATF 16949** 
 compliance, drives
 **APQP/PPAP** 
 , leads
 **problem solving and customer quality** 
 , manages
 **SQE** 
 , and ensures all products meet safety, reliability, and performance standards. You will champion a culture of
 **zero?defect, customer obsession, and continuous improvement** 
 , while guiding cross?functional teams to deliver high first?pass yields, low PPM, robust validation, and stable production.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Systems, Compliance \& Audits**
* Ensure full compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and customer?specific requirements.
* Lead internal and external audits (IATF, customer, regulatory) and close findings with sustainable actions.
* Maintain quality manuals, SOPs, Control Plans, PFMEA, inspection standards, traceability, and document control.


**NPI / APQP / PPAP Ownership**
* Lead APQP from concept → DV → PV → PPAP → SOP.
* Approve design validation (DV) and production validation (PV) plans including durability, thermal, dielectric, vibration/NVH, and EOL performance.
* Oversee PPAP submission: PSW, DFMEA/PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, SPC, Run@Rate, and capability (Cp/Cpk).
* Validate process readiness before SOP (tools, gages, measurement systems, automation, inspection plans).


**In?Process Quality \& Plant Performance**
* Own FPY, PPM, scrap, rework, and OEE?quality metrics for stator, rotor, and final assembly lines.
* Ensure robust Control Plan deployment, gage calibration, SPC on CTQs (hairpin welds, insulation integrity, press fits, magnet placement).
* Monitor and improve EOL test signatures: electrical performance, torque ripple, partial discharge, hipot, run?in vibration/noise.
* Lead Layered Process Audits (LPA), gemba walks, and containment for non?conformance issues.


**Supplier Quality Management (SQE)**
* Manage supplier quality for magnets, laminations, copper, machined parts, castings, adhesives/resins, sensors, and electronics.
* Conduct supplier audits (VDA 6\.3 preferred), approve PPAPs, ensure incoming quality checks, and track supplier PPM/OTD.
* Drive supplier corrective actions (8D), dual?sourcing risk plans, and cost?of?poor?quality reduction.


**Customer Quality \& Issue Resolution**
* Act as the primary interface for OEM/Tier?1 customers for all quality matters.
* Lead customer complaint resolution with 8D, root cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions.
* Manage warranty data, reliability growth, field returns (tear?down analysis), and customer scorecards.
* Own customer audits, QBRs, and new program readiness reviews.


**Problem Solving \& Continuous Improvement**
* Lead structured problem\-solving (8D, A3, 5?Why, Fishbone) for line issues and customer complaints.
* Support Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen projects focused on yield, scrap, equipment uptime, and process capability.
* Enable digital quality dashboards, data analytics (FPY, PPM, Cp/Cpk, warranty), and predictive insights.


**Leadership \& Team Management**
* Lead a team of Quality Engineers, Technicians, Inspectors, and SQE.
* Define skill matrices, training needs, certification levels, and audit competencies.
* Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Electronics or Computer Science Engineering.
* 2\-10 years of experience in electric motor design/manufacturing, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership position within a Tier\-1 supplier/OEM.
* Hands\-on experience with motor manufacturing processes: lamination stamping/stacking, hairpin/conventional winding, insulation systems, laser welding etc.
* Familiarity with IATF 16949/ISO 9001 systems and production part approval
* Strong data analysis experience (Minitab, Power BI, SPC tools)
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and decision making under ambiguity


**L\&T Company Overview / About Us**
 L\&T is a USD 30 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi\-Tech Manufacturing, and Services, operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer–focussed approach and the constant quest for top\-class quality have enabled L\&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for eight decades.
   

  

 Given L\&T’s capability in strategic electronics and leveraging its foray into semiconductor design and well\-established capabilities in L\&T Technology Services, the business is expanding its offerings to cover industrial electronic modules, products and systems in critical sectors of Power Electronics, Automotive Electronics, Industrial Robotics \& Automation, Communication Platforms and Electronic Systems Design \& Manufacturing (ESDM). The focus products under Automotive Electronics are ADAS, Electrification \& Connectivity related products.

description:

 EPS Mobility
   

  

**Role:** 
 Quality Manager/Engineer \- Motor
   

  

 The Quality Manager/Engineer is responsible for establishing, implementing, and maintaining world?class quality systems for
 **EV traction motors** 
 —covering stator, rotor, and motor assembly processes. The role ensures
 **IATF 16949** 
 compliance, drives
 **APQP/PPAP** 
 , leads
 **problem solving and customer quality** 
 , manages
 **SQE** 
 , and ensures all products meet safety, reliability, and performance standards. You will champion a culture of
 **zero?defect, customer obsession, and continuous improvement** 
 , while guiding cross?functional teams to deliver high first?pass yields, low PPM, robust validation, and stable production.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Systems, Compliance \& Audits**
* Ensure full compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and customer?specific requirements.
* Lead internal and external audits (IATF, customer, regulatory) and close findings with sustainable actions.
* Maintain quality manuals, SOPs, Control Plans, PFMEA, inspection standards, traceability, and document control.


**NPI / APQP / PPAP Ownership**
* Lead APQP from concept → DV → PV → PPAP → SOP.
* Approve design validation (DV) and production validation (PV) plans including durability, thermal, dielectric, vibration/NVH, and EOL performance.
* Oversee PPAP submission: PSW, DFMEA/PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, SPC, Run@Rate, and capability (Cp/Cpk).
* Validate process readiness before SOP (tools, gages, measurement systems, automation, inspection plans).


**In?Process Quality \& Plant Performance**
* Own FPY, PPM, scrap, rework, and OEE?quality metrics for stator, rotor, and final assembly lines.
* Ensure robust Control Plan deployment, gage calibration, SPC on CTQs (hairpin welds, insulation integrity, press fits, magnet placement).
* Monitor and improve EOL test signatures: electrical performance, torque ripple, partial discharge, hipot, run?in vibration/noise.
* Lead Layered Process Audits (LPA), gemba walks, and containment for non?conformance issues.


**Supplier Quality Management (SQE)**
* Manage supplier quality for magnets, laminations, copper, machined parts, castings, adhesives/resins, sensors, and electronics.
* Conduct supplier audits (VDA 6\.3 preferred), approve PPAPs, ensure incoming quality checks, and track supplier PPM/OTD.
* Drive supplier corrective actions (8D), dual?sourcing risk plans, and cost?of?poor?quality reduction.


**Customer Quality \& Issue Resolution**
* Act as the primary interface for OEM/Tier?1 customers for all quality matters.
* Lead customer complaint resolution with 8D, root cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions.
* Manage warranty data, reliability growth, field returns (tear?down analysis), and customer scorecards.
* Own customer audits, QBRs, and new program readiness reviews.


**Problem Solving \& Continuous Improvement**
* Lead structured problem\-solving (8D, A3, 5?Why, Fishbone) for line issues and customer complaints.
* Support Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen projects focused on yield, scrap, equipment uptime, and process capability.
* Enable digital quality dashboards, data analytics (FPY, PPM, Cp/Cpk, warranty), and predictive insights.


**Leadership \& Team Management**
* Lead a team of Quality Engineers, Technicians, Inspectors, and SQE.
* Define skill matrices, training needs, certification levels, and audit competencies.
* Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Electronics or Computer Science Engineering.
* 7\-13 years of experience in electric motor design/manufacturing, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership position within a Tier\-1 supplier/OEM.
* Hands\-on experience with motor manufacturing processes: lamination stamping/stacking, hairpin/conventional winding, insulation systems, laser welding etc.
* Familiarity with IATF 16949/ISO 9001 systems and production part approval
* Strong data analysis experience (Minitab, Power BI, SPC tools)
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and decision making under ambiguity


**L\&T Company Overview / About Us**
 L\&T is a USD 30 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi\-Tech Manufacturing, and Services, operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer–focussed approach and the constant quest for top\-class quality have enabled L\&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for eight decades.
   

  

 Given L\&T’s capability in strategic electronics and leveraging its foray into semiconductor design and well\-established capabilities in L\&T Technology Services, the business is expanding its offerings to cover industrial electronic modules, products and systems in critical sectors of Power Electronics, Automotive Electronics, Industrial Robotics \& Automation, Communication Platforms and Electronic Systems Design \& Manufacturing (ESDM). The focus products under Automotive Electronics are ADAS, Electrification \& Connectivity related products.

title: Supplier Quality Engineer - Casting & Machining
description:
**Are you a highly motivated, creative individual, passionate about Quality standards ?**
**Would you like to be a part of global sourcing, Quality team?**
**Join our team!**
 Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company, who delivers across the energy value chain through our market\-leading business segments. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward! Making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
   

  

**Partner with the best**
 Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE)’ is responsible for driving exceptional product quality from External suppliers to ensure customer value beyond expectations, regulatory assurance, and optimized Cost of Quality. This is a key technical position, affecting part quality for both installed base and New Product Introductions parts.
   

  

 In nutshell, Supplier Quality Engineer is expected to deliver on supplier approval, qualification, quality sustenance and continuous improvement towards achieving best quality products on time every time in a compliant way
   

  

 As a Supplier Quality Engineer \- Casting \& Machining
 **,** 
 you will also be responsible for:
   

  

  

* Demonstrating leadership in communicating business goals, programs, and processes for an area or business segment. In this role you will use your experience or expertise to solve problems, develop and execute objectives for self and others and have the ability to effect short\-term and some long\-term business goals.
* Driving quality for assigned suppliers, improving quality performance via facilitating continuous process improvements at supplier facility
* Driving supplier approval through robust on boarding processes
* Driving and developing a strong QMS mind set at supplier site ; Accelerate improvements in supplier quality and deliver value
* Developing positive relationships and work closely with Sourcing Leaders to manage and implement supplier/engineering changes, New Product Introductions, and transfers
* Interfacing with Suppliers and Supply chain to drive Quality improvements
* Delivering results as measured by key metrics, such as supplier yield, field cost, field defect rate, supplier quality plan engagement/effectiveness, and corrective \& preventative action closure
* Driving improvements utilizing Supplier Scorecards and own Supplier audit, ensuring supplier compliance, and driving improvement plans
* Understanding and driving Lean, Six Sigma culture with suppliers / processes.
* Providing Quality Engineering expertise requiring advanced/specialized skills and a broad range of quality engineering expertise
* Specifying, developing, and accept advanced technology, quality information and test equipment
* Providing advanced Quality Engineering of new product introduction involving new processes or advanced automated equipment
* Providing technical expertise to customers/licensees in solving technical problems associated with test facilities
* Acting as consultant to the Quality, Manufacturing and Engineering organizations to improve Quality and Manufacturing processes, introduce new products and improve product design
* Specifying and developing product acceptance/test procedures that relate to a complex process (state\-of\-the\-art) or highly complex product
* Providing leadership role during investigations of major problems and of special projects


**Fuel your passion!**
 To be successful in this role you will:
   

  

  

* Have minimum diploma or bachelors Degree in Mechanical/Production/Automotive Engineering or relevant
* Have 4\+ years’ experience in quality / manufacturing / vendor development functions.
* Have hands on experience in Investment \& Sand\-casting processes, qualifications including dimensional inspections
* Have an ability to manage multiple qualifications and work with global teams to approve/qualify suppliers and improve their performance.
* Have an ability in reviewing documents and parts according to ASTM, PED, IEC, ANSI, CE, CSA, UL other international standards \& Regulatory Requirements.
* Have an ability to understand and establish appropriate inspection/measurement system based on the geometry /tolerance and part profile.
* Have an ability to understand drawings, dimensioning and geometrical tolerancing (GT)
* Have hands on experience in one or more of these fields (Machining process, methods /techniques; Ability to prepare manufacturing process plan (MPP) for machining, by selecting process steps, suitable machines, conducting FMEA and preparing control plans; Knowledge on selection of tools \& Fixtures; Strong knowledge about castings (investment, sand), Forgings processes /material; Experience in NDT techniques including RT, UT and LPI and knowledge about such testing machines
* Have a strong EHS background, familiar with India Environmental, health, and safety law and regulations
* Have a very Strong Result Oriented Mindset; and process improvement approach.
* Have an exposure to ISO 14001 and OSHAS Standards will be added advantage\\
* Have an ability to communicate effectively at all levels
* Have a highest Level of Integrity
* Willingness to travel for more than 50% of the time
* Have a strong oral and written communication, interpersonal and leadership skills
* Have an ability to cope with multiple complex situations daily, guide and influence others
* Sourcing experience /prior Oil \& Gas Industry experience.
* Green Belt / Black Belt certified (GE employees only)
* Have an international Experience. \-Lead Auditor Certification\- ISO\-9001/2000 \-Negotiation expertise is preferred


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.
   

  

 Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive
   

  

**Working with us**
 Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well\-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
   

  

**Working for you**
 Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect.
   

  

  

* Contemporary work\-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
* Comprehensive private medical care options
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits


 The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Sourcing Experienced Professional \- Supplier Quality Engineering
   

  

**About Us:**
 We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
   

  

**Join Us:**
 Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.
   

  

 Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

title: System Integration Consultant
description:
**Company Description** 
 TechGuard Labs Foundation is a joint Israel–India cybersecurity center established in 2026 in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, by leading academic and industry partners including SNR Sons Trust, Ariel University, ERA IT Consulting \& Audit Ltd, and Promitei Ltd. The center combines proven Israeli cybersecurity methodologies and assessment techniques with deep Indian expertise to strengthen cyber resilience for enterprise, institutional, and public sector organizations. TechGuard operates across the full cybersecurity lifecycle, including risk and readiness assessment, governance, continuous monitoring, incident response, and recovery. Anchored in India and supported by international partners, the organization is committed to adapting to evolving regulatory, threat, and technology environments. TechGuard values excellence in strategy, compliance, technology, and talent to deliver robust cyber\-resilience solutions.
 



**Role Description** 
 The System Integration Consultant is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Greater Coimbatore Area. This role is responsible for assessing client business processes and technical environments, designing integration architectures, and implementing secure, scalable connections between cybersecurity platforms, enterprise applications, and infrastructure components. The consultant collaborates with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, map data flows, configure interfaces, and validate end\-to\-end system performance. Day\-to\-day activities include conducting technical and functional analyses, preparing integration and migration plans, coordinating implementation timelines, and supporting testing, documentation, and knowledge transfer. The consultant also provides ongoing advisory support to clients, helping them optimize integrated solutions for resilience, compliance, and operational efficiency.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong analytical skills to evaluate complex systems, data flows, and cybersecurity requirements.
* Consulting experience, including stakeholder engagement, requirements gathering, and solution recommendation.
* Hands\-on integration skills across applications, platforms, and infrastructure, with familiarity in APIs, middleware, and data mapping.
* Project management capabilities to plan, coordinate, and track integration initiatives, including timelines, risks, and deliverables.
* Business process understanding to align technical solutions with organizational workflows and compliance needs.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, standards, and best practices (e.g., network security, identity and access management, incident response) is highly beneficial.
* Experience working with enterprise systems (such as ERP, CRM, SIEM, SOAR, or cloud platforms) and integration tools is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; relevant certifications in integration, cybersecurity, or project management are a plus.
* Effective communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams and with external partners.
* Willingness to work on\-site

title: ATE Digital & Mixed-Signal Validation / Test Development Engineer
description:

 We are looking for an ATE Digital \& Mixed\-Signal Validation/Test Development Engineer to support semiconductor product validation, characterization, and production test development. title: Bench High-Speed Interface Validation Engineer
description:
Bench High\-Speed Interface Validation Engineer
 



  




* Location: Coimbatore, Bengaluru, India
* Work Mode: Onsite
* Experience: 3\- 10 Years



  





 Role Overview
 



  





 We are looking for a Bench High\-Speed Interface Validation Engineer with hands\-on experience in silicon validation, characterization, and high\-speed interface testing. The role involves developing validation platforms, performing first silicon bring\-up, board\-level debugging, protocol compliance testing, and automation for next\-generation semiconductor devices. The engineer will work closely with Design, Signal Integrity, PCB, Firmware, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Develop, integrate, and debug bench validation setups for high\-speed semiconductor interface devices.
* Perform first silicon bring\-up, engineering validation, functional verification, and characterization.
* Design, review, and debug evaluation boards, interface boards, adapter boards, daughter cards, interposers, breakout boards, and custom validation fixtures.
* Perform board bring\-up, power sequencing validation, schematic review, PCB review, and board\-level debugging.
* Develop validation platforms considering controlled impedance routing, differential pair routing, impedance matching, insertion loss, return loss, skew matching, and signal integrity.

* Execute protocol compliance, interoperability, BER testing, jitter analysis, eye diagram measurements, equalization tuning, and link training validation.
* Capture and analyze waveforms, timing diagrams, protocol transactions, and high\-speed signal behavior using laboratory instruments.
* Develop automation scripts for instrument control, data acquisition, regression testing, characterization, and reporting.
* Debug hardware, firmware, software, silicon, and board\-level issues while supporting NPI, Engineering Validation (EV), Reliability, Product Qualification, and Customer Validation activities.
* Prepare validation procedures, compliance reports, characterization reports, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams to resolve validation and product performance issues.

* Determine whether effectiveness plans are required, ensure applicable plans are implemented, and ensure required verification or validation activities are completed.
* Identify the Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) required to contribute to or own deliverables associated with the NC/CAPA; assign NC/CAPA action owners and appropriate reviewers and approvers; and coordinate cross\-functionally with Quality, Manufacturing, R\&D, Supply Chain, Procurement, and other stakeholders to implement containment, corrective, and preventive actions.
* Include the qualified person in decisions where required by applicable regulations.
* Ensure NC/CAPA records adhere to Good Documentation Practices (GDP); create, route, track, and close records in the QMS; maintain product information and traceability of decisions and actions; and edit containment records as necessary, provided the related NC/CAPA records are not in completed or closed status.
* Communicate status, risks, and outcomes of investigations and CAPAs to key stakeholders and management in a timely manner.
* Ensure NC/CAPA processes and records are audit\-ready and compliant with company policies, procedures, cGMP, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Participate in continuous improvement activities for the NC/CAPA process, including metrics collection and trend analysis.
* Provide support and guidance on NC/CAPA process expectations and use of the QMS as needed.
* Make routine investigation and record\-management decisions independently within approved procedures.
* Obtain QA approval for formal conclusions, risk assessments, CAPA plans, extensions, disposition, and closure.
* Involve the Qualified Person where batch certification, release, or regulatory commitments may be affected.
* Escalate resource commitments, ownership conflicts, significant residual risk, or procedural exceptions to functional management or governance, as applicable.



  





**Profile and Minimum Qualifications** 



* Proven ability to perform independent work that requires attention to detail, accuracy, and sound scientific or technical judgment.
* Experience in conducting investigations, root cause analysis, and risk assessments in a regulated environment.
* Aptitude to comprehend, analyze, and interpret process and system information, technical procedures, reports, and regulations to make GMP\-compliant decisions.
* Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills; adept at stakeholder engagement and active listening.
* Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Proficient in written and verbal English.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with QMS software is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of Quality Systems processes inclusive of cGMP and FDA regulations preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across multifunctional teams and build relationships with process owners and business partners.
* Demonstrated proactive ownership, strong accountability, and solid organizational skills.
* At least two years of relevant industry experience preferred.



  





**Desired Competencies** 



* Root cause analysis tools (e.g., 5 Whys, Fishbone/Ishikawa, FMEA)
* Risk\-based decision making
* Project management and prioritization
* Audit readiness mindset and experience supporting internal/external audits
* Continuous improvement orientation



  





**Key Performance Indicators** 



* Percentage of NC and CAPA investigations completed within target timelines.
* Percentage of CAPAs confirmed effective through effectiveness review.
* Trend in repeat nonconformances related to closed CAPAs.
* Number and trend of audit findings related to the NC/CAPA process.
* Quality of documentation, measured by completeness, compliance, and required rework.

description:

Troubleshooting: Address and resolve technical issues on regular production items in real time. Data\-Driven Improvement: Cultivate a continuous learning environment utilizing a data\-based analytical approach to optimize processes. Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Attend and actively contribute to daily rejection reviews and process meetings. Technical Reporting: Prepare and present data for weekly technical meetings. Project Tracking: Track and execute identified projects in a timely manner to systematically reduce rejection rates. Resource Readiness: Ensure all process inputs, materials, and documentation are ready for production. Shop Floor Communication: Facilitate clear and effective communication across the shop floor to align team objectives. Project Management: Report on project progress, define clear next steps, and escalate matters requiring management decisions or actions. System Optimization: Drive continuous system improvements based on the PDCA (Plan\-Do\-Check\-Act) methodology.

+ Problem Solving: Efficient data collection, root cause analysis, and resolution of day\-to\-day quality and build issues.
+ Continuous Improvement: Measurable progress on improvement projects, specifically
+ targeting cycle\-time reduction and quality enhancement.
+ Process Proving: Successful process validation and proving of all new development items and newly introduced processes.

**Role Summary**
**We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer to validate the performance, safety, and integrity of centrifugal pumps in compliance with API/ISO standards. Key responsibilities include managing test setups, analysing pump performance, overseeing unit testing, monitoring noise/vibration, and troubleshooting mechanical issues.**
**Responsibilities:**
* Ensure all testing complies with safety protocols and industry standards (e.g., API, HI standards).
* Analyse test loop setup for pump performance testing and NPSH testing.
* Perform hydraulic performance and mechanical testing (vibration, bearing, seal, NPSH) on centrifugal pumps.
* Compare actual test results against design specifications and international standards like API 610 or ISO 9906\.
* Verify alignment, balancing, and fitment clearances of components.
* Calculate and plot the testing parameter arrived from pump performance testing, NPSH testing, complete unit testing, mechanical run testing etc.
* Study the actual performance test result and calculate impeller trimming and other hydraulic modification to arrive required curve.
* Perform hydraulic modification of casing and impeller to achieve the pump performance based on test result.
* Analyse and provide the solution for vibration, noise and other mechanical issues.
* Develop the data base for the pump testing.
* Achieve first pass of pump performance testing.
* Inspect the hydraulic parts and analyse the performance testing.
* Identify and diagnose root causes of failure or performance discrepancies.
* Collaborate with design and manufacturing teams to suggest product improvements based on test data

**Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or closely related engineering discipline.**
**7–10 years of relevant experience in centrifugal pump industry**
**Demonstrate performance and NPSH testing calculations.**
**Expertise in API 610, HI and ISO standards for testing.**

**Working knowledge in pump testing will be an added advantage.**
